rules.statement: An action for a declaration of title on property included in the estates of deceased persons requires compliance with section 547 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: The plaintiffs cannot, however, be allowed the advantage of a final determination unless and until the provisions of section 547 of the Civil Procedure Code are complied with.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 547 of the Civil Procedure Code
